children: Argentina's soybean and corn harvests are expected to rise in the 2026/27 season to 53.6 million metric tons and 66 million tons, respectively, the Buenos Aires Grains Exchange said on Tuesday.

The estimates compare to the 50.1 million tons of soybeans harvested in the 2025/26 season and the 64 million tons of corn collected. For 2026/27 wheat, the exchange said output would fall to 23.4 million tons, down from the 27.8 million tons produced the previous season.
Total grain production could reach a new record in the upcoming cycle, the exchange said.
